_help: Windows only — on Linux/macOS archive-list.linux-macos.json (bsdtar) already lists tarballs. Lists a tarball's members as text in Quick Look using Git for Windows' GNU tar, which reads through the compression layer (7z would only show the inner .tar of a .tar.gz). Preview generator config — see docs/generators.md for the full guide. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_" when loading.
_help_extensions: Compression is detected from the file itself, so no -z/-j/-J. A plain .gz that isn't a tarball shows no preview. .zst stays with archive-list (7z): Git for Windows ships no zstd for tar to call.
_help_cmd: Git for Windows' GNU tar — the regular installer puts it here; a scoop install is at %USERPROFILE%\scoop\apps\git\current\usr\bin\tar.exe (write the path out, Waydir doesn't expand %VAR% in cmd). Not Windows' own C:\Windows\System32\tar.exe: that bsdtar prints names in the console code page, so non-ASCII names come out garbled.
_help_args: --force-local stops GNU tar reading the C: in a Windows path as a remote host:path. --quoting-style=literal prints non-ASCII names as-is instead of octal escapes like \343\202\265.
